sectionHint: Does the model load this skill for the right requests? Sends sample prompts to a model.
title: Skill eval: {name}
intro: Each case is one request. The model (the Translate engine and model in Settings) sees every library skill's name and description and says which one it would load. A case passes when it loads this skill as expected, or leaves it alone when it shouldn't load it. Each case is one model call and spends quota.
promptPlaceholder: A request a user might type…
budgetHint: The run stops at the first cap reached and skips the remaining cases. Cost is checked before each call, so it can go over by at most one call.

stopped.calls: Stopped at the call cap: the remaining cases were skipped.
stopped.cost: Stopped at the cost cap: the remaining cases were skipped.
stopped.wallclock: Stopped at the time cap: the remaining cases were skipped.
stopped.error: Stopped after two failed calls in a row (login or network?): the remaining cases were skipped.
